pages.text: One attempt costs:$(li)1 Chromatic Compound$(li)3 Quantum Circuit$(li)3 Flux Matrix$(li)3000 mB lava$(li)3 Refined Radiance$(li)3 Shadow Steel$(br2)A core drops 40% of the time, so expect about 2.5 attempts per core.
pages.title: Cost per Attempt

pages.text: Per core, on average, the failures give back:$(li)0.5 Refined Radiance$(li)0.5 Shadow Steel$(li)0.5 Flux Alloy$(br2)Feed failures back in. It is still a net loss: an attempt uses 6 radiance and shadow steel, and returns at most 1.
